author: David Norman (GB)
quote: We've paid HubSpot around £1,450 a month since 2024.
full_text: We've paid HubSpot around £1,450 a month since 2024. It renewed at the old tier anyway. ...a separate quote had to be activated ten days beforehand. The eventual answer was no credit, no adjustment, wait twelve months. We're now billed £142 a month for contacts we don't use. Software is fine; we're leaving anyway.
how_checked: checked live 26 Oct 2026 with WebFetch (Chrome not used tonight); each sentence above confirmed on the page. Title "Good software, no interest in keeping customers", 1 star, no company reply.
